content: webauthn-rs's finish_passkey_registration/finish_passkey_authentication only validate the assertion/attestation signature and return Passkey/AuthenticationResult -- they do not parse, return, or store PRF/hmac-secret clientExtensionResults. PRF results (credential.getClientExtensionResults().prf.results.first/.second) are a browser-API-level output on the raw PublicKeyCredential object obtained from navigator.credentials.create()/get(), read entirely client-side in JS before the credential is even serialized and POSTed to the server. Confirms the zero-knowledge two-ceremony pattern: server (webauthn-rs) only ever sees the signature/attestation half of the ceremony; PRF bytes never appear in any Rust type this crate exposes.
